content.title: Moelis hires veteran tech banker Timothy Roepke from Jefferies, sources say
content.summary: -Moelis has hired veteran technology banker Timothy Roepke from Jefferies as the boutique investment bank continues to expand its technology M&A franchise, according to people familiar with the matter.  Moelis and Jefferies declined to comment.  Roepke is expected to start at Moelis in early 2026 and will report to Moelis’ Global Head of Technology Investment Banking Jason Auerbach, the sources said.
